m: Under the *moon*, a runner on the *road* gives a *glare* at the pain in his **leg**.
At *sunrise*, the hunter holds up the *moon*-pale bear and feels his **courage** swell.
Dip a *writing brush* in *water drops*, then lick the tip: it tastes of **saliva**.
A *standing person* in the *valley* does what everyone there has always done: local **custom**.
Between one *chili* and another *chili* floats a hot *small speech bubble*: a fiery **debate**.
By *moon*light, a *blanket* covers a *pit* where *scissors* cut open a treasure box: the treasure **chest**.
The *sun* peeks over a *tall stool* on the window sill: **dawn**.
A *strong arm* flexes and lifts the barrel with sheer **strength**.
Behind the *curtains*, a *knife* cuts the last *shell* in half: the family is **poor**.
A *standing person* lays *two planks* over the ditch so others can cross: how **kind**.
A *standing person* walking under an *archway* spots a *paw print* **by chance**.
A *cart* rolls through town while a *mouth* asks questions and an *ear* listens, to **compile** the stories.
*Wheat* covers every *hillside*: a farming **nation**.
A *standing heart* and a *left hand* relight the cold *campfire* to **restore** its warmth.
Under a *tree*, a *mouth* begs, a *bent knife* trims a *shell* to sell: they **rely on** each other.
Inside a *fence*, a beast with *horns* parts the *curtains* and a *bowing man* walks around it in a **circle**.
A *helping hand* reaches over the *grass* in the *sun* to **touch** the *big man*'s face in the dark.
A *standing person* and a *kneeling man* both tilt their heads to **look up** at the stars.
*Water drops* splash at the *gate* where the *king* stands: his robe is **moist**.
A *sparrow* hops on a big *pile* of *soil*: a **pile** of dirt.
A *stone* falls off the *scaffold* and hits the *antlers* of a deer: a loud **bump**.
A *boat* glides with one *long stride*, a man with a *shoulder pole* pushing it: a small **boat**.
A *grain stalk* with *sprinkles* of frost under the *moon*: it bends **slightly**.
On the *road*, you stop to measure every step with a *ruler*: you will be **late**.
A *cart* rolls onto a *balance scale*, then another: the inspector counts them one by one, the **counter for vehicles**.
A *right hand* tears down the old *shed*: they **abolish** it.
*Icicles* melt and a *bent knife* scrapes the plate: now it is **clean**.
*Scissors* thrown into a *pit* stab back up at you: a **fierce** trap.
Under a *fishing net*, an official with *grey hair* sits in the *sun* at his **office**.
A *lying man* with a *chili* in his *mouth* rests against *soil* piled into a **wall**.
*Footsteps* halt at a *stop sign*, a *kneeling man* raises a *pestle*: ready to **defend** the gate.
Lift *wheat* up through the *curtains* to **offer** it to the gods.
A *square* tile on the dance floor where you **spin** round and round.
*Trudging feet* in a *winter coat* kick up *two sparks* of ice: it is **winter**.
Carry a *stone* out of the dark *shed* at the mountain: an ore **mine**.
A *helping hand* and an *elbow* work together, a *mouth* counts "three!" and you **lift** the sofa.
A *bug* hides under a *bolt of cloth* and lays a tiny **egg**.
The *sun* rises and a *clam* opens its shell: it is **morning**.
A *standing person* and a *dog* drop flat in the grass to **lie low**.
Open your *mouth* in a big *yawn* and **blow** out the candles.
A *right hand* grabs a *bird* in the farmyard: a **chicken**.
A *standing person* climbs the *podium*, opens their *mouth* and says "two **times** two is four!"
Mash *rice* with a *cross*-shaped spoon, taste it with your *mouth* under the *moon*: sticky **paste**.
*Wheat* and a *grain stalk* behind *curtains*: the rich granary of the **Qin** dynasty.
By a *leaning cliff*, a soldier holds up a *cross*-marked board with an *eye* hole: a **shield**.
Carve a *tree* branch, hang it under an *awning* beside a *fortune stick*: your new wooden **cup**.
Pay with a *grain stalk* to borrow a *stepladder*: you **rent** it.
A *big man* hammers a *nail* into a saddle, puts a carrot in the *horse*'s *mouth*, and climbs on to **ride**.
A *slide* down a long *winding path* on a *flat tyre*: you arrive **tired**.
A **grand** palace towers high on the *hillside*.
A *small speech bubble* asks a *person* how he feels while the doctor checks his *bristles* of hair to **diagnose** him.
A *woman* is dragged off by a rough *right hand* and forced to work as a **slave**.
A *helping hand* cups an *ear*, while a *right hand* and another *right hand* gather every sound: you **take in** everything.
A broken shape, missing its pieces: everything you had, you **lose**.
*Water drops* drip from a *leaky pot* into the mud: everything gets **dirty**.
A *right hand* paddles through the *water drops* to **cross** the river.
A *square* of cloth flaps on a pole: a **flag**.
*Grass* chewed between *two planks* of teeth tastes like *candy*: so **sweet**.
A man with a long *beard* bites his *thumb* to **endure** the pain.
A *standing person* rests his *shoulder pole* on a *small table*: he can **rely on** it to hold the weight.
A *helping hand* grabs a *ski* pole and you **prick** your finger on its tip.
A *helping hand* reaches past a *person* and a *bowing man* to **grab** the last ticket.
A *silk thread* trails from an old woman with *grey hair* sitting in the *sun*: follow the **thread** of her story.
*Rice* piled on a *stepladder* in a **thick** heap.
Carry a *door* home under the *moon* on your **shoulder**.
A whole *tree* trunk laid across the roof: a **beam**.
A *cocoon* hangs behind a *bracket* and seems to move: just an **illusion**.
*Grass* and flowers with *spread wings* of petals: the meadow is **fragrant**.
*Twins* each hold a *white dove*: **all** of them have one.
A *stone* drops on a *lid* and they both **smash** to pieces.
Under the *roof*, a deep *pit* opens onto the stars: the whole **universe**.
Your *right hand* passes *crumbs* *upstairs* to your **uncle**.
A *stone* on a *mountain*: a huge **rock**.
*Grass* and *water drops* glitter under *sun rays* and **sway** in the wind.
Wind a *silk thread* under the *roof* around an *altar* to **combine** all the offerings.
A *python* grips a branch with a *talon* to **climb** the tree.
A *standing person* hammers a *nail* in the *grass* by the pond, and a *mouth* sighs at a pink **lotus**.
Follow *animal tracks* by *heart* and you **know** every path in the woods.
Wipe the *grass* off with a *towel* and pull the fruit from its **stem**.
On the *road* past a *leaning cliff*, a *right hand* waves as you **return** home.
*Two planks* crossed over *two planks*: the frame over a village **well**.
A *scholar* chops a *split log* in one blow: surprisingly **strong**.
*Grass* on a *seedbed* in *water drops*, pressed by a *thumb*: the layer is **thin**.
A *standing heart* tiptoes through *sprinkles* of *moon*light: moving **quietly**.
A *helping hand* drags a *comb* across the floor to **sweep** it.
A *mother* in a *slanted cap* catches her *cane* before it falls: so **quick**.
A *stone* left on the road at *sunrise*, as big as a *thumb* to a giant: it will **hinder** you.
A *skeleton* plants a *cross* in the field, and from it new life starts to **breed**.
A *small speech bubble* describes every curl of the *sheep*'s wool: very **detailed**.
On the *road*, you fall into a *pit*, then climb out wiser: it starts to **enlighten** you.
An *elbow* draws back and thrusts a long *spear*: a **spear**.
*Rain* pours down and a *sparrow* darts off **suddenly**.
An *elbow* nudges your *legs* forward: the guard gives his *permit* to **allow** you in.
Hang a *towel* over a *full jar* to measure its **width**.
A *helping hand* waves a *cane* and the pigeons **scatter**.
A *grain stalk*, two *spoons* and a *standing knife*: after the feast, only these **remain**.
Over the *mountain*, a *coiled rope* is tossed onto a *small table*: the climbers return in **triumph**.
In a *rice field* under a *tree*, a single **grain** falls onto a *page*.
One *mouth* and another *mouth* shout at the *horse* that kicked the cart: they **scold** it.
Hand over a shiny *shell* as a **reward**.
*Water drops* gather under a *lid*: a jar full of **liquid**.
*Animal tracks* cross a *rice field*, leaving a *footprint field* of strange prints: something **foreign** passed through.
Cut *bamboo* and *tree* wood, nail them together, and keep an *eye* on what goes in the **box**.
Lick a *shell*, tap it with a *little fortune stick*, press it to your *mouth*: now it will **stick**.
*Water drops* pour all day under the *sun* until the river starts to **overflow**.
Lift the *wine jug* with your *elbow* and sip: it has gone **sour**.
A **young man** gallops down the *hillside* to see his bride.
Under the *moon*, a dancer ties a sash around her **waist**.
A *person* lies back, *elbow* behind his head, *fishing line* in the water: time to **relax**.
Draw a curved *eyebrow* line just over the *eye*: an **eyebrow**.
A *standing heart* stares at a new *wart* and starts to **worry**.
*Water drops* lift a *child* while a *claw* holds her up: she learns to **float**.
Put a *chili* on the *podium* and mark it with a *cross*: the most **spicy** of all.
Lift the *lid* off a box and find a *heart* inside: it's **love**.
An *old skeleton* reaches out a *right hand* for *food*: time for a **meal**.
A *mouth* shouts "boo!" from *downstairs*: what a **scare**.
A *helping hand* holds a *shoulder pole* upright while you take a *long stride*: walk tall and **straight**.
At the *cliff*, a *swarm* of friends cheer and a *strong arm* pulls you up: they **encourage** you.
Your *tongue* tastes a hot *chili* at the boss's dinner, and you decide to **resign**.
A *right hand* pushes one *boat* out, then another, as the harbour master counts each: the **counter for ships**.
Press *gold coins* with a *long stride* of a *writing brush* across the board: each one is a **key**.
A *standing person* wraps a *spool* of thread around five soldiers: one **squad**.
*Trudging feet* climb past *wheat* fields up the *mountain* to its **peak**.
A *lying man* stretches one leg in a *sweep* beside a *ruler*: exactly one **Chinese foot**.
The *sun* set behind *two planks* of the fence: that was **yesterday**.
Endless dark rows of millet in the field: a **multitude**.
Birds with *spread wings* fly over a *cart* that carries the old to the young: each **generation**.
A *fence* with a *cross* in the middle and a *shell* behind: a spear will **pierce through** them all.
A *standing person* checks a *little fortune stick* and a *shell* for secret messages: a **spy**.
*Water drops* on a *bone* make it **slippery**.
A beast with *horns* behind the *curtains* bites a *knife*-cut stub: your **ticket**.
On a *mountain*, under a *roof*, stands an *altar* high above the clouds: **lofty**.
A *helping hand* keeps poking your *wart* to **disturb** you.
Under one *roof*, a *cow head* stands on its *legs* as the law of the farm: the **constitution**.
A *silk thread* is wound round and round a *tall stool*: **wind around** it.
A *runner* holds a *bent knife* and a *comb*, rushing to the barber: **hurry**!
A deer with *antlers* curls up by a *cocoon* and another *cocoon*, warming them with its *heart*: so **kind**.
A *dancer* stretches up on her toes: so **tall**.
At the *gate*, a beast with *horns* rests on its *legs*, *mouth* moving as it learns to **read**.
*Water drops* drip from a shirt on the *drying rack*: it is soaked with **sweat**.
A *tree* reaches out a thin *branch* to hold a nest: a leafy **branch**.
A *helping hand* in a *slanted cap* grabs a *scorpion* by the tail and starts to **drag** it.
*Soot* mixed into *soil* and pressed into a stick: Chinese **ink**.
Under the *moon*, a *strong arm* pulls back the *curtains* to **threaten** the sleeper.
A *helping hand* tries to **insert** a straw into a *mortar* full of a *thousand ants*.
A *bamboo* shaft with *antlers* for fletching, cut under the *moon* with a *standing knife*: an **arrow**.
Under the *moon*, meat hangs from a *hurdle* to dry in the *sun*: **cured meat**.
Grind *rice* behind the *curtains* with a *knife* until it becomes **powder**.
A *lying man* digs a *spoon* into *water drops* and earth: **mud**.
Branches of the *family tree* each carry one name: the **surname**.
